spell.name: Kunai Strike
spell.desc:
Adaptor : Throw a volley of kunai at the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ physical damage. If the target is Burning, deal an additional @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ damage.

Adaptor : If the Ability kills, cast it again.

spell.name: Defensive Sweep
spell.desc: Slice the target for @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ physical damage and gain @AbilityShield@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

spell.name: Razor Leaves
spell.desc:
Summon five razor-sharp leaves that converge on the current target, dealing a total of @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ physical damage and applying @WoundLevel@% Wound and @BurnAmount@% Burn for @WoundDuration@ seconds.

Scarlet Buff: Cinderling gains @TraitADOnCast@ Attack Damage each cast.

Wound: Reduces healing received.
Burn: Deals a percent of the target's max Health as true damage every second.

spell.name: Karmic Bond
spell.desc:
Tether the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage over @TetherDuration@ seconds. Then release a burst of power around them, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@ magic damage to all enemies in a @AoEHexRange@ Hex radius and @SlowPercent@% Slowing them for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

Slow: Reduce Attack Speed

spell.name: Dance of Life
spell.desc: Restore @HealthCalc1@ Health over @Duration@ seconds. The next attack is replaced with a bash that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage.

spell.name: Shield Bash
spell.desc:
Passive: Start combat with @GenericCalc1@ bonus Armor and Magic Resist that decays over @DecayDuration@ seconds.

Active: Bash the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

spell.name: Bellows Breath
spell.desc:
Active: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage to enemies in a cone.

Quest: Each player combat, Ornn stores damage blocked as Forge Power, increased by @DamageTaken3StarScalar@ at 3-star. Gain an Artifact Anvil each time he gains enough Forge Power. (Forge Power: @Stack@ / @GenericCalc1@)

spell.name: Azure Laser
spell.desc:
Begin consuming @PercentManaPerSecond@ max Mana per second and channeling a laser on the target. Each second while casting, deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage to them and reduce their Magic Resist by @MRReduction@.

Teal Buff: Gain @TraitManaRegenTooltip@ Mana Regen for every @TraitChannelSecondsTooltip@ seconds channeled.

spell.name: Entrancing Dance
spell.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then grant the ally who has dealt the most damage this combat @AttackSpeedCalc1@ decaying Attack Speed for @AttackSpeedDuration@ seconds.

spell.name: Uproot
spell.desc:
Passive: Restore @HealthCalc2@ Health each second, tripled for @SpellMultiplierDuration@ seconds after casting.

Active: Lunge out of the ground, Stunning adjacent enemies for @KnockupDuration@ second and dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage to them.

spell.name: Piercing Arrow
spell.desc: Wind up, then fire an arrow at the most enemies in line with the target. It deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ physical damage to enemies hit, reduced by @DamageReductionPerHit@ for each enemy it passes through (minimum @MinDamagePercent@).

spell.name: Primordial Burst
spell.desc:
Launch a giant blast at the target that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage, increased to @MagicDamageCalc2@ if they're below @HPThreshold@ max Health.

If they die, permanently gain @APOnKill@% Ability Power.

Current bonus: @Stack@%

spell.name: Deadly Plumage
spell.desc: Gain @AttackSpeed@ Attack Speed for the next @NumAttacks@ attacks. These attacks are replaced with feathers that deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ physical damage and reduce Armor by @GenericCalc1@ .

spell.name: Last Rites
spell.desc:
Passive: On death, spawn a Spirit Walker with @HealthCalc2@ max Health which immediately taunts, forcing enemies to attack it.

Active: Restore @HealthCalc1@ Health and strike the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ physical damage.

spell.name: Triumphant Roar
spell.desc: Roar, restoring @HealthCalc1@ Health, cleansing disables, and healing the two lowest percent Health allies for @HealthCalc2@ . Then slam the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

spell.name: Headshot
spell.desc: Passive: Every third attack is replaced with a Headshot that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ physical damage.

spell.name: Spider Queen
spell.desc: Transform into a spider and gain @SpiderHealthBuff@ max Health. Attacks while in Spider Form deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ bonus magic damage and heal for @HealthCalc1@ . Subsequent casts grant @DecayingAS@ decaying Attack Speed for @ASBuffDuration@ seconds.

spell.name: Belchy Bubble
spell.desc:
Adaptor : Belch a noxious bubble at the current target that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage. Enemies within a 1 hex radius of the explosion take @MagicDamageCalc2@ magic damage over @PoisonDurationAP@ seconds.

Adaptor : Heavily slows the target.

Purple Buff: Every @TraitTimer@ seconds, Gromp gains @TraitTimedAP@ Ability Power.

spell.name: Solar Judgement
spell.desc:
Passive: Kayle ascends based on her star level, granting her stacking bonuses.

1st Ascension: Attacks deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ bonus magic damage.
2nd Ascension: Attacks @ShredLevel@% Shred enemies hit for @ShredDuration@ seconds.
3rd Ascension: Attacks fire waves, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@ magic damage to all other units hit.
4th Ascension: Gain infinite range. Every @NumAttacksForBigWave4Star@rd wave is much larger.

Shred: Reduce Magic Resist

spell.name: Mirror Image
spell.desc:
Passive: After player combat, your strongest LeBlanc has a @PercentChanceToPrint@ chance to create a copy of an ally on your board, increased by @PercentChanceToPrintKillBonus@ per takedown.

Active: Launch a mirror image at the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage and @MagicDamageCalc2@ to adjacent enemies.

spell.name: Rending Claws
spell.desc:
Leap to the lowest Health enemy within @LeapHexRadius@ Hexes and deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ physical damage. The next @NumEmpoweredAttacks@ attacks gain @EmpowerAspd@ Attack Speed and deal @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ bonus physical damage.

Grey Buff: Gain Precision and @TraitBaseCrit@ Critical Strike Chance, increased up to @TraitBonusCrit@ based on missing Health.

spell.name: Can You Dig It?
spell.desc:
Passive: Attacks are replaced by a dance that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ physical damage to all adjacent enemies.

Active: Burrow underground, gaining @BurrowDurability@ Durability for @BurrowDuration@ seconds and healing @HealthCalc1@ over the duration.

Green Buff: When allies fall below @TraitHealthThreshold@ Health, they restore @TraitPercentHeal@ max Health.

spell.name: Sun's Wrath
spell.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then cleave in a cone, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage and strike in a line, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@ magic damage to enemies hit.

spell.name: Ki Barrier
spell.desc: Grant @ShieldCalc1@ Shield to Shen and @ShieldCalc2@ Shield to a nearby damaged ally for @MagicShieldDuration@ seconds. Both of their next @NumAttacksBuff@ attacks gain @AttackSpeedBuff@ Attack Speed and deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ bonus magic damage.

spell.name: Fungus Among Us
spell.desc:
Throw 2 clusters of mushrooms that deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage to the @NumEnemiesHit@ nearest enemies. Then hurl a giant mushroom that deals @MagicDamageCalc2@ magic damage to the target.

Each cast has a @PercentChanceOfForage@ chance to forage an extra mushroom that can be collected for bonus effects.

Red: @RedRerolls@ Reroll (Reds Foraged: @Stack@)
Green: @GreenHealth@ Tactician Health (Greens Foraged: @GenericCalc1@)
Yellow: @YellowXP@ XP (Yellows Foraged: @GenericCalc2@)

spell.name: Jaws of The Beast
spell.desc: Bite the current target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ physical damage and healing for @GenericCalc1@ of the damage dealt. Gain @AttackSpeedBuff@ Attack Speed for the rest of combat.

spell.name: Cultivation of Spirit
spell.desc: Dash, then launch an orb at the current target that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ physical damage and splits, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ physical damage to @NumSecondaryTargets@ nearby enemies.

spell.name: Arise!
spell.desc: Gain @AttackSpeed@ Attack Speed and summon @SoldiersToSpawn@ soldiers for the next @NumAttacks@ attacks. These attacks are replaced by commands which direct each soldier to deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage per attack.

spell.name: Noxious Blast
spell.desc: Poison the target and the nearest non-poisoned enemy, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage over @Duration@ seconds. Poisons stack.

spell.name: Pale Barrier
spell.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and send out @NumOrbs@ moonlight orbs spread among enemies within 2 hexes, each dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage.

spell.name: Harvest
spell.desc: Reduce the Magic Resist of the @NumTargets@ nearest enemies by @MRReduction@. Then drain life from them over @CastDuration@ seconds, healing for @HealthCalc1@ Health and dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage to each over the duration.

spell.name: Spirit of Dread
spell.desc: Gain @Resists@ Armor and Magic Resist for 3 seconds and restore @HealthCalc1@ Health over the duration. Launch spectral riders at the @NumEnemies@ nearest enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

spell.name: Taste Their Fear
spell.desc: Leap to the farthest enemy within @LeapRangeHexes@ Hexes, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage. If they have no adjacent allies, deal @MagicDamageCalc2@ magic damage instead and gain @IsolateManaGrant@ mana.

spell.name: Raining Artillery
spell.desc:
Adaptor : Launch acid at the target and the other nearest enemy, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ physical damage. Enemies below @ADBonusDamageThreshold@ max Health take @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ physical damage instead.

Adaptor: Damages enemies over time.

spell.name: Rock and Roll
spell.desc:
Passive: On death, split into two Kruglettes with @HealthCalc1@ Health which immediately taunt, forcing enemies to attack them.

Active: Gain @HealthCalc2@ max Health, then roll into the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ damage.

Slate Buff: On death, Krug and Kruglettes Shield allies for @TraitShieldHealth@ max Health.

spell.name: Flock Family
spell.desc:
Summon 4 untargetable Tiny Beaks nearby for @GenericCalc1@ seconds. Whenever Mama Beak attacks, Tiny Beaks attack the same enemy, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ physical damage.

Orange Buff: Dealing physical damage reduces enemy Armor by @ArmorReduc@.

spell.name: Wuju Style
spell.desc:
Passive: Every third attack is a Double Strike. On takedown, gain a burst of movement speed.

Adaptor : Double Strikes grant @AttackSpeedCalc1@ stacking Attack Speed.

Adaptor : Double Strikes deal bonus damage and heal.

spell.name: Defensive Ball Curl
spell.desc:
Taunt, forcing enemies to attack this champion. For @Duration@ seconds, gain @ShieldCalc1@ Shield and @ArmorMR@ Armor and Magic Resist.

When the Shield breaks, deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ physical damage to enemies in @DamageHexRange@ Hexes.

spell.name: Savagery
spell.desc: Jump to the lowest percent Health enemy within @JumpHexRange@ hexes and stab them, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ physical damage. Then heal for @HealthCalc1@ , increased to up to @HealthCalc2@ based on their missing Health.

spell.name: Explosive Charge
spell.desc:
Attach an explosive charge to the target that lasts @Duration@ seconds. While active, gain infinite range and @AttackSpeedCalc1@ Attack Speed. After the duration, the charge explodes and splits damage between all enemies within 2 hexes, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ physical damage + @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ for each attack while casting.

If an enemy with an explosive charge on them dies, it attaches to Tristana's new target.

spell.name: Furious Fists
spell.desc:
Passive: On attack, restore @HealthCalc1@ Health.

Active: Unleash a primal roar, restoring @HealthCalc3@ Health. Then gain @SpellAS@ Attack Speed, @SpellDurability@ Durability, and is unstoppable for @SpellDuration@ seconds.

spell.name: Spirit Bomb
spell.desc: Launch a spirit bomb at the location within @AbilityCenterHexRange@ hexes that has the most surrounding enemies. It deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage to enemies in a @HexRadius@ hex radius, reduced by @HexPercentDamageFalloffTooltip@ per hex away from the epicenter.

spell.name: Tantrum
spell.desc:
Passive: Every second, restore @HealthCalc1@ Health and deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage to enemies within @PassiveHexRadius@ hex.

Active: Deal @MagicDamageCalc3@ magic damage to enemies within @BigHexRadius@ hexes and Stun them for @StunDuration@ seconds, increased to @GenericCalc1@ seconds if the target is Burning.

Burn: Deals a percent of the target's max Health as true damage every second.

spell.name: Moonlight's Onslaught
spell.desc:
Equip Severum and swipe the target @GenericCalc1@ times over @Duration@ seconds, each dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ physical damage.

After the onslaught finishes, fire a blast that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ physical damage split among all enemies in a 2 Hex radius.

spell.name: Crimson Fury
spell.desc:
Passive: When the target dies, leap at the next target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ physical damage.

Active: Gain @FrenzyADPercent@ Attack Damage for @Duration@ seconds. During this time ignore @GenericCalc1@ Armor.

Red Buff: Attacks @BurnAmount@% Burn enemies and heal Brambleback for @TraitMaxHealthHeal@ max Health.

spell.name: Forest's Flurry
spell.desc:
Blink away from the current target, deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ physical damage to them, and gain @AttackSpeedCalc1@ Attack Speed.

Every 4th cast consumes the Attack Speed granted from Forest's Flurry and fires a blast through the largest group of enemies that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ physical damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerHit@ for each enemy it passes through (minimum @MinDamagePercent@).

spell.name: Lilting Lullaby
spell.desc: Restore @HealthCalc1@ Health and send @NumEnemiesToFireAt@ butterflies at nearby enemies. Enemies hit take @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage and Sleep for @SleepDuration@ seconds. If they take @DamageNeededToAwaken@ damage, they wake up and take an additional @WakeupDamage@ max Health magic damage.

spell.name: Petrified Bark
spell.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and become petrified. When the shield breaks, unleash a wave of dark energy, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage to enemies within @AoEHexRange@ hexes.

spell.name: Withering Curse
spell.desc:
Passive: Gain @Omnivamp@ Omnivamp.

Active: Fire a dark blast at @NumEnemiesCursed@ nearby enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage to them and cursing them for @SpellDuration@ seconds. Then, spawn a @HexRangeAOE@ Hex withering zone for the same duration that deals @MagicDamageCalc2@ magic damage per second. Cursed enemies take @MagicDamageCalc3@ more damage per curse.

spell.name: Javelin Toss
spell.desc:
Adaptor : Gain @BonusAttackSpeed@ Attack Speed for the next @NumEmpoweredAttacks@ attacks. These attacks are replaced with javelins that deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage. The 3rd attack instead targets the furthest enemy with the least items and deals @MagicDamageCalc2@ magic damage.

Adaptor : Transform into a Melee cougar Assassin that swipes enemies.

spell.name: Azure Shockwave
spell.desc:
Gain @ShieldCalc1@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Slam the ground, sending a fissure in the direction of the most enemies. Enemies hit are briefly knocked up, take @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage, and are Mana Reaved for @ManaReaveFlat@.

Blue Buff: Each time Sentinel casts, allies gain @TraitAlliesManaRegen@ Mana Regen.

Mana Reave: Increase the Mana cost of the next Ability cast.

spell.name: Haymaker
spell.desc:
Passive: Upon falling below @ManaHPThreshold@ max Health the first time each combat, gain 100 mana.

Active: Wind up a big punch, rapidly healing for @HealthCalc1@ before dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ physical damage in a large cone.

spell.name: Boomerang Blade
spell.desc: Throw a large crossblade that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ physical damage to the current target and bounces @NumBounces@ times between nearby enemies, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ physical damage each bounce. When this kills an enemy, bounce @BonusKillBounces@ additional times.

spell.name: Starcall
spell.desc: Call down a star on the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage. If a star has previously fallen on them, call down @NumAdditionalStars@ additional stars that each deal @MagicDamageCalc2@ magic damage.

spell.name: Rampant Growth
spell.desc: Spawn @NumPlantsToSpawn@ plants around the battlefield that attack the nearest enemy @ThornSpitterNumAttacks@ times. Each attack deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage.

spell.name: Moonfall
spell.desc:
Rain @NumMoonshards@ moonshards split among the @NumEnemies@ nearest enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage each.

If the moon is full, instead crash it onto the board, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@ magic damage split among all enemies.

spell.name: Spirit Rift
spell.desc:
Fire an arrow through the most enemies in a line that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ physical damage, reduced by @DamageFalloffPerEnemy@ per enemy hit (minimum @MinDamagePercent@). If no enemies are hit refund @ManaRefund@ of mana spent.

The arrow leaves a trail for @RiftDuration@ seconds that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ + @MaxHealthDamagePerSecond@ max Health physical damage per second to enemies within and @ChillPercent@% Slows them.

Slow: Reduce Attack Speed

spell.name: Whirling Death
spell.desc:
Passive: Attacks target random enemies in range and apply a bleed that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ physical damage over @BleedDuration@ seconds. Every attack has a @GenericCalc1@ chance to deal @SpinningAxeDamageRatio@ bonus physical damage and apply @SpinningAxeBleedStacks@ bleeds instead.

Active: Throw two giant axes towards the enemy with the most bleeds. Deal @PhysicalDamageCalc3@ physical damage to enemies hit and consume their bleed, instantly dealing the remaining damage. The axes then return, dealing @GenericCalc2@ physical damage to enemies hit. If no enemies are hit refund @ManaRefund@ of mana spent.

spell.name: Heat Without Equal
spell.desc:
Passive: Attacks deal @AttackAoERatio@ damage to enemies adjacent to the target.

Active: Become invulnerable and fly into the air. On return, stun all enemies for @StunDuration@ seconds, gain @Omnivamp@ Omnivamp, and Ignite them for @IgniteDuration@ seconds. Ignited enemies take @IgniteMaxHealthDamage@ max Health physical damage per second. Replace this ability with Flame Breath and immediately cast it.

Flame Breath: Spew fire at the most enemies in a line through the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ physical damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerHit@ for each enemy it passes through (minimum @MinimumDamageThreshold@.) Ignite those enemies for @IgniteDuration@ seconds.

Elder Dragon Buff: Damaging an enemy below @TraitExecuteThreshold@ Health executes them.

spell.name: Rage Gene
spell.desc:
Passive: Gain @RagePerSecond@ Rage per second and @RagePerAttack@ Rage per attack.

Active: Transform into Mega Gnar and leap into the largest group of enemies within @TransformSearchRadius@ hexes. Then, deal @PhysicalDamageCalc3@ physical damage to enemies within @TransformHexRadius@ hexes, reduce their Armor and Magic Resist by @GenericCalc1@ , and Stun them for @StunDuration@ second. Mega Gnar gains @HealthCalc1@ Health, and replaces his Ability with Grab n' Throw.

Grab n' Throw: Throw the target at the farthest enemy, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ physical damage to them and @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ physical damage to enemies they pass through. If there's only 1 enemy left, throw them off the battlefield instead.

spell.name: Triggerseed
spell.desc:
Passive: Shields from this Ability can critically strike with Precision.

Active: Grant @NumAlliesToShield@ allies @ShieldCalc1@ Shield and @DamageAmpAmount@ Damage Amp for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage to enemies adjacent to them. After casting @CastThreshold@ times, also grant @AttackSpeed@ stacking Attack Speed to targets.

spell.name: Firestorm
spell.desc:
Charge up, gaining @APPerBurningEnemy@ Ability Power per Burning enemy. Then, gain @ShieldCalc1@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and rush through a nearby group of enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage to each.

After rushing, unleash a @FirestormHexRadius@ Hex firestorm that deals a total of @MagicDamageCalc2@ magic damage split among all enemies hit over @FirestormDuration@ seconds.

spell.name: Final Spark
spell.desc:
Passive: On cast, all allies that share a trait with Lux gain @ManaCalc1@ mana.

Active: Fire a laser towards the largest group of enemies that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerUnit@ for each enemy hit.

spell.name: Sow the Seeds
spell.desc:
Passive: After every @DamageMitigatedPerSapling@ damage blocked, a sapling jumps towards a nearby enemy and deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ magic damage. On death, @SaplingsOnDeath@ saplings jump out.

Active: Deal @MagicDamageCalc2@ magic damage to target and restore @HealthCalc1@ + @ActiveMissingHealthHeal@ missing Health.

spell.name: Emerald Radiance
spell.desc:
Passive: The first time Taric or his paired ally drops below @PassivePercentHealthThreshold@ Health, unleash emerald energy from both of them, granting @ShieldCalc1@ Shield to allies within @PassiveHexRadius@ Hexes for @PassiveShieldDuration@ seconds.

traits.desc:
Having an Avatar on your bench or board transforms all other Avatars in your shop to the Trait of that Avatar.

An Avatar's chosen Trait is counted twice for Trait bonuses.

traits.desc:
The ally on the Blackthorn hex is sacrificed before combat, granting your champions Health.
